content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑fat butter crackers are light, crisp biscuits made from whole‑grain flour, vegetable oil and a modest amount of salt. They have a delicate buttery flavor, a crunchy texture, and fewer calories than regular butter crackers.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The lower fat content is achieved by using low‑density vegetable oils and incorporating air‑binding agents.
These crackers are popular as a diet‑friendly snack and as a side for soups and salads.
Whole grains such as wheat, rye or oats are often included, boosting dietary fiber.
The product is marketed as a healthier alternative to traditional butter crackers.

items.title: Reduced fat content
items.content: Lower fat levels help decrease overall calorie intake, supporting weight management.

items.title: Good source of dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain base provides fiber that promotes regular digestion.

items.title: Provides complex carbohydrates
items.content: Crackers deliver slow‑release energy, helping maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Whole grains supply thiamine, niacin and folate, essential for metabolism.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: Reduced salt makes the snack more suitable for people monitoring blood pressure.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: These crackers usually contain wheat, so they are not suitable for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some varieties may include artificial flavors or preservatives that could trigger reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Potentially high glycemic index
items.content: Large portions may raise blood sugar, especially for people with diabetes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Crackers can be enjoyed as a standalone snack, served with soups, salads, dips, or used as a base for canapés. They are convenient for on‑the‑go meals or work breaks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight package. For extended shelf life, keep refrigerated to preserve crispness.
